import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Total sales by product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = data.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color='#2E86AB')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by payment method
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
payment_sales = data.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum()
colors = ['#A23B72', '#F18F01']
ax2.pie(payment_sales.values, labels=payment_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Sales by customer age group
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_sales = data.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_sales.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color='#C73E1D')
ax3.set_title('Total Sales by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
takeaway_sales = data.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
ax4.bar(takeaway_labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=['#6A994E', '#BC4749'])
ax4.set_title('Sales: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 5. Sales over time
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
hourly_sales = data.groupby('time')['total'].sum()
ax5.plot(range(len(hourly_sales)), hourly_sales.values, marker='o', 
         linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax5.set_title('Sales by Time of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Time')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(hourly_sales)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(hourly_sales.index, rotation=45)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Product size distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
size_dist = data['size'].value_counts()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_dist = size_dist.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in size_dist.index])
ax6.bar(size_dist.index, size_dist.values, color='#E76F51')
ax6.set_title('Product Size Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Size')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')

# 7. Average price by product
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
avg_price = data.groupby('product')['price'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
avg_price.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, color='#8338EC')
ax7.set_title('Average Price by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Product')
ax7.set_ylabel('Average Price ($)')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 8. Quantity sold by product
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
quantity_by_product = data.groupby('product')['quantity'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
quantity_by_product.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax8, color='#FB5607')
ax8.set_title('Total Quantity Sold by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Product')
ax8.set_ylabel('Quantity')
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
